# Flagsmith API Reference

> Flagsmith's Core and SDK APIs. Check out <a href='https://docs.flagsmith.com'>Flagsmith documentation</a>.

## API Reference

- [Flagsmith API](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html): Flagsmith's Core and SDK APIs. Check out <a href='https://docs.flagsmith.com'>Flagsmith documentation</a>.
- [GET /api/__future__/environments/{environment_key}/features/{feature_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-future-environments-environment-key-features-feature-id-get): GET /api/__future__/environments/{environment_key}/features/{feature_id}/ - Read what the flag serves in the environment.
- [PUT /api/__future__/environments/{environment_key}/features/{feature_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-future-environments-environment-key-features-feature-id-put): PUT /api/__future__/environments/{environment_key}/features/{feature_id}/ - Replace the properties given, resetting what they omit.
- [PATCH /api/__future__/environments/{environment_key}/features/{feature_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-future-environments-environment-key-features-feature-id-patch): PATCH /api/__future__/environments/{environment_key}/features/{feature_id}/ - Update the properties given, leaving the rest as they are.
- [DELETE /api/__future__/environments/{environment_key}/features/{feature_id}/segment-overrides/{segment_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-future-environments-environment-key-features-feature-id-segment-overrides-segment-id-delete): DELETE /api/__future__/environments/{environment_key}/features/{feature_id}/segment-overrides/{segment_id}/ - Remove the flag's override for the segment, leaving the rest of the flag as it is.
- [Delete segment override](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-experiments-environments-environment-key-delete-segment-override-post): POST /api/experiments/environments/{environment_key}/delete-segment-override/ - **EXPERIMENTAL ENDPOINT** - Subject to change without notice.
- [Update single feature state](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-experiments-environments-environment-key-update-flag-v1-post): POST /api/experiments/environments/{environment_key}/update-flag-v1/ - **EXPERIMENTAL ENDPOINT** - Subject to change without notice.
- [Update multiple feature states](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-experiments-environments-environment-key-update-flag-v2-post): POST /api/experiments/environments/{environment_key}/update-flag-v2/ - **EXPERIMENTAL ENDPOINT** - Subject to change without notice.
- [GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/integrations/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-admin-dashboard-integrations-get): GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/integrations/
- [GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/organisations/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-admin-dashboard-organisations-get): GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/organisations/
- [GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/release-pipelines/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-admin-dashboard-release-pipelines-get): GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/release-pipelines/
- [GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/stale-flags/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-admin-dashboard-stale-flags-get): GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/stale-flags/
- [GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/summary/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-admin-dashboard-summary-get): GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/summary/
- [GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/usage-trends/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-admin-dashboard-usage-trends-get): GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/usage-trends/
- [POST /api/v1/analytics/flags/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-analytics-flags-post): POST /api/v1/analytics/flags/ - Class to handle flag analytics events
- [POST /api/v1/analytics/telemetry/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-analytics-telemetry-post): POST /api/v1/analytics/telemetry/ - Class to handle telemetry events from self hosted APIs so we can aggregate and track
- [GET /api/v1/audit/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-audit-get): GET /api/v1/audit/
- [GET /api/v1/audit/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-audit-id-get): GET /api/v1/audit/{id}/

- [POST /api/v1/auth/{method}/deactivate/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-method-deactivate-post): POST /api/v1/auth/{method}/deactivate/
- [POST /api/v1/auth/login/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-login-post): POST /api/v1/auth/login/ - Class to handle throttling for login requests
- [POST /api/v1/auth/login/code/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-login-code-post): POST /api/v1/auth/login/code/ - Override class to add throttling
- [POST /api/v1/auth/logout/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-logout-post): POST /api/v1/auth/logout/ - Use this endpoint to logout user (remove user authentication token).
- [GET /api/v1/auth/mfa/user-active-methods/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-mfa-user-active-methods-get): GET /api/v1/auth/mfa/user-active-methods/
- [POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/github/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-oauth-github-post): POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/github/
- [POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/google/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-oauth-google-post): POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/google/
- [POST /api/v1/auth/oidc/token/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-oidc-token-post): POST /api/v1/auth/oidc/token/ - Exchange an OIDC token issued by a trusted identity provider for a short-lived Flagsmith access token.

- [POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/amplitude/lists/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cohort-sync-amplitude-lists-post): POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/amplitude/lists/ - Called by Amplitude once per cohort sync setup; creates the backing cohort and returns its identifier as the list ID.
- [POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/amplitude/lists/{id}/add/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cohort-sync-amplitude-lists-id-add-post): POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/amplitude/lists/{id}/add/
- [POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/amplitude/lists/{id}/remove/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cohort-sync-amplitude-lists-id-remove-post): POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/amplitude/lists/{id}/remove/
- [POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/mixpanel/webhook/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cohort-sync-mixpanel-webhook-post): POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/mixpanel/webhook/ - Called by Mixpanel every sync cycle with the cohort's full membership (`members`) or the changes since the last sync (`add_members`/`remove_members`).
- [POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/add/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cohort-sync-webhook-cohorts-id-members-add-post): POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/add/ - Add members to a CSV cohort. Accepted deltas are applied to identity data asynchronously. Re-adding a member is a no-op, so retries are safe.
- [POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/remove/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cohort-sync-webhook-cohorts-id-members-remove-post): POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/remove/ - Remove members from a CSV cohort. Accepted deltas are applied to identity data asynchronously. Removing a non-member is a no-op, so retries are safe.

- [POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-post): POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/ - Create a cohort and the managed segment that targets it.
- [GET /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-cohort-id-get): GET /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/ - Retrieve a cohort.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-cohort-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/ - Request cohort deletion. Memberships are drained from identity data first; the cohort and its segment are deleted once drained.
- [PATCH /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-cohort-id-patch): PATCH /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/ - Update the cohort's managed segment name, description and metadata.
- [POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/sync-csv/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-cohort-id-sync-csv-post): POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/sync-csv/ - Replace the cohort's members with the identifiers found in the uploaded CSV file and trigger a sync to identity data. `identifier_column` is the 0-based index of the column holding the identifiers; `has_header` skips the first row when true.
- [GET /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-sync-keys-get): GET /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/
- [POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-sync-keys-post): POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/ - Create a cohort sync key. The response is the only time the plaintext key is available.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/{prefix}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-sync-keys-prefix-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/{prefix}/ - Revoke a cohort sync key.
- [POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/create-change-request/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-create-change-request-post): POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/create-change-request/ - Creates a new change request for feature flag modifications in an environment.
